messages:
alex: Heads-up — saw a big spike of SLO 'p95 latency' alerts in the console for a bunch of small tenants around 10:12. Traffic doesn't match the spike. Are inherited thresholds being applied twice in notify routing?

mira: Saw that too. My hypothesis: inheritance is resolved, but notify fanout runs on the pre-sampled evaluation set and may duplicate when routes overlap. pinging @sam for the routing/dedupe logic.

sam: We resolve inheritance at evaluation time (we merge org -> tenant -> route), but notify fanout can create multiple notifications if multiple route mappings reference the same underlying metric. I'll grab logs. Example query I ran:
```
SELECT rule_id, tenant_id, count(*) FROM notify_dispatch WHERE rule_hash = 'abc123' GROUP BY 1,2;
```

platform-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: quota-channel fanning detected for rule slo_high_95_latency (x27 duplicates)

josh: Looks like dedupe_key generation is the culprit — we're currently using `metric_id + window` and missing tenant id when an inherited policy is attached to multiple route aliases. That means different tenant/routed paths can end up with same key.

alex: If true, that would dramatically amplify noise for inherited rules. Low-risk fix: include tenant id and policy version in dedupe key. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

mira: Totally. From UX side we also need to surface "inherited from" in the thresholds UI and indicate whether a rule is currently being deduped across routes so support doesn't get flooded. That's a common ask.

sam: I can prototype change today: `dedupe_key = f"{tenant_id}:{policy_id}:{rule_hash}:{window}"` and run a canary on a few low-traffic regions. Would add a small schema bump to notify payload. Any objections?

josh: No objections. Please add a short migration note for past incidents (how long duplicates might persist).

lia: Also propose adding telemetry: `notify.dedupe.hits` and `notify.dedupe.per_rule` so we can measure impact and drive a rollback if needed. Expose in per-rule telemetry panel.

alex: Great. Can frontend add a tiny flag in the console to show inheritance origin (org/tenant/route) and a dashed icon if dedupe is active? We should ship that this sprint.

mira: I’ll file a tiny frontend PR after design sync and attach a screenshot mock.

sam: Plan: implement dedupe key change + telemetry + canary in staging tomorrow morning, run for 6h, then roll to prod if duplicate rate drops. Will post rollout checklist here.

josh: If rollout goes well, follow-up: surface a per-rule "noise score" in console (simple metric combining duplicate hits + notify rate / baseline). That would help teams detect inherited-noise early.

alex: Love that. Thanks everyone — please @channel when the canary is live so support can mute affected notification channels temporarily.

mira: filing tickets: FE-1058 (show inherited origin), PLAT-1892 (dedupe key fix), TELE-433 (dedupe telemetry).

sam: Canaries scheduled for 2734580000-2734583600 UTC (tentative). I'll update thread with results.

platform-bot: Deployment scheduled: notify-service v2.14.1 -> canary (region: us-west-2)
